title: Harry Styles receives Guinness World Record for longest Wembley Stadium run
facts: Harry Styles was awarded a Guinness World Record for the longest run of concerts at Wembley Stadium.
Harry Styles completed 12 sold-out shows at Wembley Stadium to break the official residency record.
The band Coldplay held the previous Wembley Stadium residency record with 10 nights in 2025.
Will Munford served as the official Guinness World Records adjudicator for Harry Styles' achievement.
The London leg of Harry Styles' Together, Together tour began on June 12, 2026.
The final show of Harry Styles' record-breaking Wembley Stadium run was attended by approximately 80,000 people.
Harry Styles' former boyband One Direction formed in 2010 on the TV talent show The X Factor.
The boyband One Direction went on an indefinite hiatus in 2016.
Former One Direction bandmate Liam Payne died at the age of 31 in 2024.
Harry Styles officially launched his solo music career in 2017.
Harry Styles has received six Brit Awards throughout his solo career.
Harry Styles released his fourth studio album, "Kiss All The Time. Disco, Occasionally", in January 2026.
Wembley Stadium unveiled a commemorative banner to officially mark Harry Styles' 12-show record.
Harry Styles chose to play his current tour exclusively in London for the United Kingdom leg.
Taylor Swift previously performed for eight nights at Wembley Stadium in 2024.
